name: Nanao
source:
A seven-tailed fox.

She was once sealed away by the ancestors of Shimizu, the chief priest of the shrine, but recently, she has begun to appear and harm the village once again.

She swears revenge against the chief priest who sealed her away, and turns on Masakazu, who has become the chief priest even though he the replacement. She has a complex about the fact that he has only seven tails, and becomes enraged at any mention of it.

She is interested in Masakazu because he has a constitution that attracts evil spirits, and he will try to mess with him in any way he can.

Her favorite food is cup yakisoba.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_miko2.htm]official site[/url]]
